creative_brief.emotional_promise: Open a pocket-sized night sky, trace one welcoming path, then discover that every turn and flip can suggest a new creature or constellation.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Four compact pages give the nine-piece visual inventory and open-ended play grammar room to breathe while remaining small enough to sit beside the three-tile-wide storage mosaic.
creative_brief.physical_format: Four-page portrait 6 × 8 inch booklet with 0.35 inch safe margins and no bleed-dependent content.
teaching_arc: Meet and count all nine tiles.
Identify Crescent, Comet, and Star by tactile dots and corner pips.
Grow and name a first three-tile weave.
Try Snowflake, Dragon, and Crown as open prompts.
Troubleshoot, care for, and safely store every piece.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold — display and section wayfinding
DejaVu Sans — instructions, labels, and safety copy
creative_brief.visual_motif: Centered starlight gates become a repeated path across panels; rounded cards echo the exact tile silhouette, while constellation dots mark the reading order.

findings: Page 4's mosaic count caption overlapped the bottom tile row in both color and grayscale.
The first-render footer labels sat below the declared 0.35-inch safe margin on every page.
Small coral headings lost contrast in grayscale, the reset actions were compressed, and the guided weave did not mark its gate contacts.
resolved_changes: Raised and shortened the mosaic grid, moved the count caption below it, and enlarged the panel so text and tiles no longer overlap.
Raised every footer rule and label by 16 points, placing the labels inside the 0.35-inch safe area.
Darkened the coral accent, separated all three reset actions onto their own lines, marked both guided gate contacts, and increased the smallest safety copy to 8 points.
